# Incident template

Copy this template into a new document when an incident starts.

## Summary

One or two sentences: what is broken and who is affected.

## Timeline

Times in UTC. Add an entry for every action taken and who took it (use roles, not names).

## Impact

Which services, how many users, and for how long.

## Follow-up actions

Each action has an owner role and a due date. Review the list in the next weekly
operations meeting.
